concept.title: Strength and balance classes to prevent falls
concept.shortdesc: As an older person worried about falling, I need strength and balance exercise, so that I stay steady and keep my independence.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-029). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: older people, people at risk of falls.
Situation: Prevention is the purpose; activity is the means.
A good result: Falls-prevention classes suited to age and ability, with referral needs and cost.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.

ul.li: strength and balance for older people
